$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one base corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch, because the data root moved from /mnt/playpen/mailwoman-data to /mnt/mw on 2026-09-23 and the previous record's absolute paths stopped resolving.
$registers-note: This record carries every address register read for #2323. All eighteen write their input through `mailwoman corpus fetch <id>`: a fetcher writes under `$MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT/corpus/sources/<adapter id>/`, and an adapter that wants one file or one subdirectory inside that directory states it through its own `…InputPath` helper, which is where each `inputPath` below comes from.
$policy-note: Gipuzkoa's register entry elects CC-BY-SA-4.0 and is absent here for want of a fetcher rather than for its licence. When it gains one, a build behind a published model runs `--license-policy share-alike-free`, which refuses its rows and records the refusal in `refused_rows_by_source`. `internal/strategy/mailwoman-cc-by-sa-training-model-rights-2026-10-03.md` states why that exclusion is a release decision rather than a finding that share-alike reaches trained weights.
